_comment: The bestiary's sprite manifest: every creature variant, per species, in the order a
player MEETS them (forest/mire d0, ashfall 250, desert 400, tundra 550).
A variant is one CHARACTER and one asset folder. `<key>` is the ordinary creature, and
`<key>_pack_leader` is the one leading a pack; everything else is a sibling of the
ordinary form, so a pack of five draws five different bodies instead of one sprite at
five sizes. Variants are also where roles will hang: a `_mage` or a `_healer` is
already drawn as something that casts.
The driver only makes what is MISSING - a variant already complete on disk is skipped
without even needing its character id - so this file is the roster, not a queue.
style: in a weird HD-2D fantasy style
